entries.title: Semantic control inputs
entries.summary: Keyboard commands and joystick port 2 provide the Reference Build's player-action surface.

entries.title: Player and vehicle movement
entries.summary: Movement changes position and orientation according to the active locomotion mode and its constraints.

entries.title: Player-relevant timing
entries.summary: Input cadence, motion, messages, interactions, and transitions have case-specific PAL timing measurements.

entries.title: Core interaction mechanics
entries.summary: Boarding, leaving, taking, dropping, activating, firing, pausing, and situation-reset actions change observable state under specific preconditions.

entries.title: Object identities and interactions
entries.summary: Object slots have stable Geometry Identities, mutable placement/state, visibility rules, and player interaction semantics.

entries.title: Vehicle modes and capabilities
entries.summary: Enterable vehicle instances differ in movement, flight, weapon, capacity, and progression capabilities while using ordinary object geometry.

entries.title: World regions and transitions
entries.summary: The surface, underground rooms, roads, structures, portals, altitude detail, and high-altitude content form one connected observable world.

entries.title: Wireframe and status presentation
entries.summary: Scene membership, detail transitions, line operations, status information, prompts, and transitions define the Reference Build's observable presentation.

entries.title: Inventory state and capacity
entries.summary: Player-carried objects, capacity constraints, pickup/drop outcomes, and reset behavior contribute to future progression.

entries.title: Credits, prices, rewards, and transactions
entries.summary: Credit balance, offers, purchases, sales, hire costs, and rewards form the player-observable economy.

entries.title: Mission offers and outcomes
entries.summary: Mission offers, requirements, delivery or destruction conditions, rewards, and faction consequences alter progression and world state.

entries.title: Progression and persistent world state
entries.summary: Completed interactions, mission state, inventory, economy, vehicles, and mutable objects constrain future choices and endings.

entries.title: Messages and authored wording
entries.summary: Message identities, exact restricted wording, trigger associations, ordering, and dismissal behavior belong to the baseline.

entries.title: Music and sound cues
entries.summary: Audio cue identities, SID event structure, trigger associations, ordering, and duration belong to the baseline while exact recordings remain restricted.

entries.title: Save and load semantics
entries.summary: Ten selectable save identities, overwrite and failure behavior, and restored future state define C64 save/load observables.

entries.title: Escape endings and materially distinct routes
entries.summary: Every reachable escape ending and materially distinct acquisition or solution route has an end-to-end journey identity.

entries.title: Meaningful quirks and unusual solutions
entries.summary: Reproducible quirks or unusual solutions are preserved when they affect progression, viable solutions, learned timing, world behavior, or characteristic identity.

entries.title: Nondeterministic outcomes
entries.summary: Random or timing-dependent encounters are bounded by decoded legal outcomes and measured fixed-seed phase-varied frequencies.
